title: Sharing truth through fair conditions

captions.physics: Clearly showing and explaining useful substance
captions.energy: Freeing meaning from a false foundation
captions.emotions: Calm through clear and proportionate conditions

meaning: Freeing meaning from a false foundation can inspire you when open shared action brings calm through fair conditions.
text: The Tower in the energy of Sahasrara supports a wish to free meaning from a false foundation or outward appearance. The Sun in the physical position appears through jointly showing useful substance openly and explaining it clearly. Justice in emotions brings calm through understandable, proportionate conditions. Presenting your contribution as it actually exists may matter to you both so that people’s real possibilities do not depend on an attractive account hiding differences between promised and available substance. Truthful foundations can become a useful public contribution when others can connect actual conditions with what has genuinely been made available.

For example, you jointly present the results of a small collection for a neighbourhood library. You show acquired books, explain spending and name what could not yet be obtained. **Clear presentation can give truthful foundations a fair shared measure.** A participant sees a contribution in an understandable result and decides whether to continue. You feel reassured that words match actions, without needing to believe the initiative is flawless.

It becomes harder if the account becomes overly detailed mainly in justification. Expenses are listed but usefulness is difficult to see. A freeing motive and a sense of fair proportion remain supportive. Action benefits from connecting clear grounds with visible benefit so people can relate conditions to what is already available.
